comment.body:
Thanks for confirming the issue is resolved on your system. A second reporter said the failure persisted after updating and has already shared a dump, so we do not need another attachment yet. @el-thatguy, if this still happens, could you please reply with:
1. The exact PowerToys version from Settings > General > About.
2. The Windows edition/version/build from `winver`.
3. Whether the current failure occurs with Win+R, your configured PowerToys Run shortcut, or both. Please try the same invocation(s) on your currently installed version; this will tell us whether any present-day failure remains.
